verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches the lineup. YubiKit docs say both USB and NFC-enabled YubiKeys exist, which implies interface variants, and a community comment calls Yubico hardware more compact and less bulky than alternatives. Nothing names specific connectors or form factors. Missing for 10: any documentation of USB-C models, USB-A models, keychain form factor, nano/low-profile form factor, and an overview of the product lineup.
